title: Rewrite Plan
description: Structured plan for revising a document based on review findings. Each revision is specific, actionable, and mapped to the issue that triggered it. Consumed by section-drafters and voice-editor.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier for this rewrite plan

draft_ref.description: Path or ID of the draft document being revised

review_id.description: ID of the review report that produced this rewrite plan

run_id.description: Cache run ID this plan belongs to

revisions.description: Ordered list of revisions to be made — blocking revisions first, then high, medium, low

revision_id.description: Unique identifier for this revision within the plan

issue_id.description: ID of the review issue this revision addresses

type.description: Type of revision: cut = remove content, rewrite = replace with new content, expand = add detail, restructure = change organization, voice-fix = correct tone or style, fact-check = verify and correct a claim, canon-fix = align with canon

scope.description: Section title, paragraph, or quoted phrase identifying what is being revised — specific enough that the drafter can locate it without ambiguity

instruction.description: Specific instruction for the revision — must be actionable and not vague (e.g. 'Cut the second paragraph of Section 3 — it repeats what was said in the intro', not 'tighten this up')

priority.description: blocking = document cannot advance until resolved; high = should resolve before re-review; medium = address before final; low = optional

agent_assignments.description: Maps revision types to the agents responsible for executing them

additionalProperties.description: Agent ID responsible for this revision type

created_by.description: Agent ID that produced this rewrite plan (typically lead-editor)
